	private final String item;
	/** Where the teleport goes, or null when the item only has one destination. */
	private final String destination;
	/** Magic level needed for spells, 0 for items. */
	private final int magicLevel;
	private final WorldPoint location;
	private final String iconPath;

	TeleportLocationData(TeleportType type, String destination, int magicLevel, WorldPoint location, String iconPath)
	{
		this(type, null, destination, magicLevel, location, iconPath);
	}

	TeleportLocationData(TeleportType type, String item, String destination, WorldPoint location, String iconPath)
	{
		this(type, item, destination, 0, location, iconPath);
	}

	TeleportLocationData(TeleportType type, String item, WorldPoint location, String iconPath)
	{
		this(type, item, null, 0, location, iconPath);
	}

	TeleportLocationData(TeleportType type, String item, String destination, int magicLevel, WorldPoint location, String iconPath)
	{
		this.type = type;
		this.item = item;
		this.destination = destination;
		this.magicLevel = magicLevel;
		this.location = location;
		this.iconPath = iconPath;
	}
}

package com.teleporthighlighter;

import lombok.Getter;

/**
 * Teleport categories. Each one can be switched on or off in the plugin settings.
 */
@Getter
public enum TeleportType
{
	NORMAL_MAGIC("Standard spellbook"),
	ANCIENT_MAGICKS("Ancient Magicks"),
	LUNAR_MAGIC("Lunar spellbook"),
	ARCEUUS_MAGIC("Arceuus spellbook"),
	JEWELLERY("Jewellery"),
	SCROLL("Scroll / tablet"),
	MINIGAME("Minigame teleport"),
	FAIRY_RING("Fairy ring"),
	OTHER("Teleport item");

	private final String label;

	TeleportType(String label)
	{
		this.label = label;
	}
}
